output:
- User collects vintage cameras and postcards; resumed collecting recently (as of Aug 2023).
- 2023/08/11: Asked for space-saving display ideas (shadow boxes, floating shelves, etc.) for a small collection.
- Same date: Sought organizing/cataloging help; feels the documentation process is overwhelming.
- Began cataloging with a spreadsheet template (title, date, publisher, condition, acquisition date/source, unique ID).
- Has 17 new postcards since restarting; provided partial list: PC001 1920s Paris (excellent, antique shop), PC002 1950s beach scene by Colourpicture (near mint, eBay), PC003 1960s Eiffel Tower at Night (used, slight crease, antique shop); remaining 14 not itemized yet.
- Acquisition sources include local antique shops and eBay.
- Interested in online collector communities; was unaware how many existed, planned to check recommended forums/groups (r/VintageCameras, Facebook vintage camera groups, etc.).
